(40a6ca2c082f79d69b89965a1b54e82df71ebaee) ``` > Task :ethereum:referencetests:validateReferenceTestSubmodule FAILED FAILURE: Build failed with an exception. * Where: Build file '/home/seamonkey/Downloads/merge-testnets/kiln/besu/ethereum/referencetests/build.gradle' line: 61 * What went wrong: Execution failed for task ':ethereum:referencetests:validateReferenceTestSubmodule'. ``` `git submodule update` fixed it I had nimbus crash on me after stopping the EL client (erigon in this case). Same thing just happened when I stopped nethermind as well. We have known issue on restart, we're working on it 😉 well this is also a Nimbus issue, I know what's happening here, it's an engine API call I just added and it doesn't check for some correctness conditions like the other calls do Hi all I'm currently testing the merge I'm following this tuto https://github.com/remyroy/ethstaker/blob/main/merge-devnet.md to run a node All went good until this moment : I'm on ubuntu running in wsl2 https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/3494/commits/7bd4f050ba5d1894328d8fbd59472fd21ba06497 should fix it well, if it's operating off an existing database and you're changing those parameters underneath it, that's going to confuse it, yes (same as if you tried to change from mainnet to kiln or vice versa using the same database) Didnt we have the issue in amphora that nimbus couldn't start from a merge genesis state and needed phase0->altair sequentially? Perhaps the same issue is hit when you set both to happen at once? No idea if that's still applicable or if it's fixed Aspects of that have been fixed since Amphora, but I experimented with running Nimbus's local testnet with that `FORK_EPOCH` configuration, and it hit: ``` nimbus-eth2/beacon_chain/nimbus_beacon_node.nim(509) init Error: unhandled exception: Invalid baked-in state: SSZ BeaconState: object dynamic portion starts at invalid offset [AssertionError] ``` because it's trying to read in a phase0 genesis when it thinks it's in Bellatrix. Even just setting `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH` to 0 caused this issue. So the code is generally capable of this, but we haven't set it up fully to work well in that configuration. I'll poke at it in `kiln-dev-auth` `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH == BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH == 1` seems to work fine (and it should), too Hi, does anyone have a static node for Ropsten EL? I have a lot of trouble finding peers, 5 if I'm lucky. <@892053833121923094> I have a question on the Hive test *Transition to a Chain with Invalid Terminal Block, Lower Configured Total Difficulty* Does anybody know ho we can include Besu in the tests on the hive2 tests website? https://hivetests2.ethdevops.io/ <@194432762315407360> can help out with this I will add it soon Wanted to redeploy today but some other things had priority

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content:
Aspects of that have been fixed since Amphora, but I experimented with running Nimbus's local testnet with that `FORK_EPOCH` configuration, and it hit:
```
nimbus-eth2/beacon_chain/nimbus_beacon_node.nim(509) init
Error: unhandled exception: Invalid baked-in state: SSZ BeaconState: object dynamic portion starts at invalid offset [AssertionError]
```
because it's trying to read in a phase0 genesis when it thinks it's in Bellatrix. Even just setting `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH` to 0 caused this issue.

So the code is generally capable of this, but we haven't set it up fully to work well in that configuration. I'll poke at it in `kiln-dev-auth`

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: `ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH == BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH == 1` seems to work fine (and it should), too
